name: ZBD-05 amphibious fighting vehicle
operator: PLA Navy Marine Corps & PLA Army amphibious units
overview_md:
The ZBD-05 (and its assault-gun sibling the ZTD-05), collectively the Type 05 family, is China's high-speed amphibious fighting vehicle — the armoured spearhead built specifically for the kind of cross-water assault a Taiwan invasion would require. Where most amphibious vehicles wallow slowly to shore, the Type 05 uses a planing hull, retractable bow plate and waterjets to skim across the sea at high speed, dramatically shortening its vulnerable approach.

The family comes in two principal forms: the ZBD-05 infantry fighting vehicle, armed with a 30 mm cannon and anti-tank missiles to carry marines ashore and support them, and the ZTD-05 amphibious assault gun, mounting a 105 mm gun to provide direct fire support during a landing. Both can launch from amphibious ships well offshore and reach speeds on water far higher than older designs, reducing exposure to coastal defences during the crossing.

For an analyst, the Type 05 is one of the clearest hardware signatures of China's amphibious-assault ambitions. It equips the expanding PLA Navy Marine Corps and Army amphibious combined-arms brigades, and its high water speed is a direct attempt to solve the central problem of an opposed landing: surviving the approach. Paired with Type 075/076 assault ships and air-cushioned landing craft, it is a core component of any cross-strait scenario.

combat_history.event: Equips PLA Navy Marine Corps and Army amphibious brigades; central to large amphibious exercises.
combat_history.significance: Hardware signature of China's amphibious-assault capability.

modernization.description: Fielded across an expanding marine and amphibious force with Type 075/076 ships.
modernization.impact: Builds the spearhead for opposed-landing operations.

vulnerabilities.context: Vulnerable to coastal defences and anti-armour fire.

vulnerabilities.description: High-speed planing degrades in rough seas.
vulnerabilities.context: Taiwan Strait weather windows are narrow.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Launch from closer or in suitable conditions.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Ship-launched high-speed assault across water to land marines and provide fire support ashore.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: Launched from Type 075/076 and amphibious ships; operates with marines and air-cushioned craft.
operational_patterns.readiness_notes: Core PLA amphibious vehicle; force expanding.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: U.S. Marine amphibious vehicles; the Type 05 emphasises higher water speed for the approach.
The Type 05 launches from China's amphibious assault ships in a landing.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: How China would mount an amphibious assault.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: Both support landings/soft terrain; the Type 15 is a light tank, the Type 05 a high-speed amphibious carrier.

doctrine.role: High-speed amphibious fighting vehicle to spearhead an opposed cross-water landing.
doctrine.employment: Launches offshore from amphibious ships and skims to shore at high speed; IFV and 105 mm assault-gun variants.
doctrine.design_philosophy: Solve the opposed-landing approach problem with high water speed.
doctrine.threat_context: A core hardware signature of China's amphibious-assault (Taiwan) capability.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read with the Type 075/076 ships, the Type 15 light tank and U.S. AAV/ACV.
